name: Notifications
author: loneycoffee
description: A bell on the bar and a panel with every notification you were sent over the last 30 days, under the day it arrived, with its app's icon, a search field and Do Not Disturb. Built on Omarchy's own notification service, which keeps showing the popups. Toggle the panel with: omarchy-shell shell toggle notification-center

barWidget.description: Notification history with search and Do Not Disturb
